title: The Blueprint *Exit*
dek: AMD paid $8.2B to claim the silicon layer. The engineer who wrote OpenAI's safety reports resigned. Florida asked a court to freeze model development.
still_signal: Every layer of the AI stack is being claimed by acquisition or deployment. The safety layer is being vacated by the people who built it.
